scope: Normal Windows player menu in private desktops. Actual game orders at four times simulated speed in isolated profiles. The published EXE runs with its Steam adapter left uninitialized.

baseline.harness_note: The evidence-only branch returns before adding the regular route summary. The reused outer test expected that extra summary and returned 1; the old effect is verified from the live event witness, not a passing suite status.
